notes.note: Reviewed the queue-regression repair at 0e9d30f: shared Project Agent management now mounts only after a server-projected Admin/Owner opens it. Viewer/contributor shared-work reads and their captured request scope remain unchanged. Actual ProjectAgentsPanel and SDK transport are retained; no installation or execution authority comes from the opener. No public SDK shape or synthetic Agent identity changed. The exact eight previously failing suites now pass: 692 tests, with only two inapplicable missing-browser sentinel cases skipped because Chromium was available; real cascade/hit-test browser cases executed. A one-line eager-admin-mount mutation failed the pre-click no-tool-reads assertion (1 failed/9 passed); byte-identical restoration was verified before the final green run. UI typecheck passed. Server fixture changes preserve distinct operator setup, Alice/Bob credential isolation, authored Agent resolution, fail-closed recovery and retained cursor. Menu fixtures retain real geometry and model the new access row. Hosted merge-candidate regression remains pending.
